method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 11 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: Nature Abhors an Infinity
picks.author: Beren Millidge
picks.why_it_matters: Argues that quantum mechanics, GR and the cosmological constant jointly close every loophole to observer-accessible infinity, from the Holevo bound to Dyson's eternal computer.

picks.title: Understanding Positional Embeddings in Modern LLMs
picks.author: Sebastian Raschka, PhD
picks.why_it_matters: Walks from GPT-2's learned absolute embeddings through RoPE to NoPE, with code, and shows what 2026 open-weight models actually use for position.

picks.title: The Mind of a Megalomaniac
picks.author: Timothy W. Ryback
picks.why_it_matters: Narrative history of a secret government report that foresaw Hitler's final two years in power, and what that says about reading a megalomaniac.

picks.title: Reading JSON at 277 GB/s in Python
picks.author: Daniel Lemire
picks.why_it_matters: Shows how free-threaded Python 3.14 and field-selective SIMD parsing reach 277 GB/s on 192 cores, and where process pools stop scaling.

picks.title: A family tree of software job titles
picks.author: umerf
picks.why_it_matters: A 104-title lineage of software jobs from 'Computer' to context engineer, showing titles split, merge and recycle, and why the AI-replaces-coding story has a 1947 precedent.
